newsitem.title: USA: Supreme Court denies Honeywell request vs Litton.
newsitem.headline: Supreme Court denies Honeywell request vs Litton.

text.p: Litton Industries Inc said on Friday the U.S. Supreme Court denied a Honeywell Inc motion to delay the return of Litton's patent infringement suit against Honeywell to the U.S. District Court in Los Angeles for a new trial.
The new trial is to determine financial damages owed to Litton, the company said in a statement.

In a related antitrust case decided in July, the same U.S. District Court in Los Angeles upheld a jury verdict that Honeywell attempted to monopolize and did monopolize the commercial market for inertial reference systems used to navigate aircraft, Litton said.
However, Litton said the judge ordered a new trial solely to establish the amount of damages payable to Litton by Honeywell.
Both the patent infringement and antitrust litigation are now awaiting new trials on damages due Litton.
